name: Bai Dinh Pagoda
kicker: Old pagoda and the new hill
summary: A pagoda hill in phường Tây Hoa Lư, about 20 km from the city. The old foundation dates to Nguyễn Minh Không in 1136, and the new complex grew from 2003 on five levels. The ground is given as 107 ha and as more than 1,000 ha. A return electric cart is 150,000 đồng for an adult. It sits about 100 km from Hà Nội. Pair it with the boat when the morning is still open.
getThere: About 20 km from the provincial centre, about 100 km from Hà Nội.
heroCaption: Lit towers and the pavilion on the water at Bái Đính

notice.title: The cart is a priced extra
notice.body: A return electric cart is 150,000 đồng for an adult and 100,000 đồng for a child from 1 m to 1.3 m. Walking entry is a separate charge at the door.

body: The old foundation dates to Nguyễn Minh Không in 1136. The new complex grew from 2003, on five levels, in phường Tây Hoa Lư. It sits about 20 km from the provincial centre and about 100 km from Hà Nội, inside the buffer of the Tràng An landscape. The ground is given as 107 ha and as more than 1,000 ha.

Two bells are named, of 36 tons and of 27 tons. The larger bell is also given as 10 m high, with a diameter of 5 m. The night frame is the lit pavilion and the towers. The second frame is that bell inside the wooden tower.

A return electric cart is 150,000 đồng for an adult. A transfer package that includes the cart, a bảo tháp ticket, and a foot soak is 300,000 đồng for an adult and 210,000 đồng for a child from 1 m to 1.3 m. A VIP cart with a guide on the cart is 4,000,000 đồng. A guide is 500,000 đồng per tour. Hotline 1900 966 909.

figures.caption: The bronze bell inside the tower, captioned at 36 tons
figures.alt: A large bronze bell hanging in the wooden tower at Bái Đính

gettingThere: About 20 km from the provincial centre, and about 100 km from Hà Nội. Tràng An’s about 90 km from Hà Nội is the other end of the valley. The support line shared with Tràng An is 02293.886.068.

legs.heading: From the valley
legs.body: Ride out to phường Tây Hoa Lư. The published distance from the provincial centre is about 20 km.

legs.heading: From Hanoi
legs.body: About 100 km by road. The train to Ga Ninh Bình is a different measure, kilometre 115 from Hà Nội, then a ride out to the hill.

admissionNote: Walking entry is charged at the door. Return electric cart: adult 150,000 đồng, child from 1 m to 1.3 m 100,000 đồng. Transfer package, with the cart, a bảo tháp ticket, and a foot soak: adult 300,000 đồng, child from 1 m to 1.3 m 210,000 đồng. VIP cart with a guide on the cart: 4,000,000 đồng. Guide: 500,000 đồng per tour. Hotline 1900 966 909. Support phone 02293.886.068.
